headword: {液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}
gloss: LCD screen; liquid crystal display screen

definitions.gloss: LCD screen; liquid crystal display screen
definitions.explanation: a flat-panel display that uses liquid crystal technology

examples.japanese: {液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}が{割|わ}れた。
{液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}の{明|あか}るさを{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: Adjust the brightness of the LCD screen.

examples.japanese: この{液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}は{解像度|かいぞうど}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This LCD screen has high resolution.

notes:
TECHNOLOGY TERMS:
- {液晶|えきしょう} - liquid crystal
- LCD - Liquid Crystal Display
- {有機|ゆうき}EL - OLED (organic light-emitting diode)
- {解像度|かいぞうど} - resolution

COMMON ISSUES:
- {液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}の{修理|しゅうり} - LCD screen repair
- {液晶|えきしょう}{漏|も}れ - LCD bleeding/leaking
- ドット{抜|ぬ}け - dead pixel

USED IN:
Smartphones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs, and various electronic devices.
